title: Construction and unit normalization of coefficient comparison morphisms
statement: Let f:X -> T be any morphism, F any module sheaf on X, U an open of T, and V_i (i in Fin r) any opens of Y=f^{-1}U. Let g:T' -> U, g':X' -> X and f':X' -> T' satisfy g' f = f' g U.ι. Let W_i=g'^{-1}(Y.ι(V_i)). Use the module sheaf, pullback and coefficient conventions of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model] and [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex]. Put G=(F|Y).presheafModuleCat and H=restriction of scalars through GammaSpecIso^{-1} followed by (f|U followed by U.toSpecGamma).appTop, then tilde over A=Gamma(U,O), then pullbacks along U.toSpecGamma and g. Put M=g'^*F. For every p and increasing tuple t let Z_t=intersection_i V_{t(i)} and W_t=intersection_i W_{t(i)}. Then there are O_{T'}-linear sheaf morphisms q_t:H(G(Z_t)) -> (W_t -> T')_*(M|W_t). Under the canonical support section identification with M(W_t intersect f'^{-1}B), they commute with every face restriction. On global sections they send the canonical generator of s in F|Y(Z_t), obtained successively from tilde.toOpen and the two pullback units (restricted from inverse images of the full opens to full opens), to the restriction to W_t intersect f'^{-1}T' of eta_{g'}(s), where s is first identified with F(Y.ι(Z_t)). No bijectivity, affine hypothesis or quasi-coherence is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the additive section map by open restriction, the pullback unit for gprime, and restriction to the support. Its structural scalar compatibility makes it a linear map. Take its mate under the composed tilde/Gamma and two pullback adjunctions; this is the explicitly defined coefficientComparisonMorphism, not a chosen existence witness. Instantiate it at each tuple intersection, using coefficientIntersection_preimage to identify the support.

Apply the generator formula for the concrete mate at each tuple intersection. The definitions of coefficientGenerator, coefficientPullbackGenerator, and coefficientSupportIso reduce to its displayed equation.

Apply face naturality for the concrete mates with the intersection equalities already proved. This is definitionally the required face equation, so the explicit family and these two properties prove the existential statement.

theorem exists_coefficientComparison_maps {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T)
    (F : X.Modules) (U : T.Opens) {r : ℕ}
    (V : Fin r → (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (w : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ (g ≫ U.ι))
    (W₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → X'.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ i, W₀ i = g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ V i.down)) :
    let G := (F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).presheafModuleCat
    let H := ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)).inv ≫
        ((f ∣_ U) ≫ U.toScheme.toSpecΓ).appTop).hom) ⋙
      tilde.functor Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) ⋙
      Modules.pullback U.toScheme.toSpecΓ ⋙ Modules.pullback g
    let M := (Modules.pullback g').obj F
    let W := fun (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r) ↦
      alternatingCechIntersection (fun i ↦ W₀ ⟨i⟩) t
    ∃ q : ∀ (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r),
      H.obj (G.obj (op (alternatingCechIntersection V t))) ⟶
        (pushforward ((W p t).ι ≫ f')).obj (M.restrict (W p t).ι),
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r)
        (s : Γ(F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι, alternatingCechIntersection V t)),
        (coefficientSupportIso f' M (W p t) ⊤).hom
          ((q p t).app ⊤ (coefficientGenerator g _ s)) =
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W p t ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ ≤ W p t)).op
          (coefficientPullbackGenerator F (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (alternatingCechIntersection V t)
            g' (W p t) (coefficientIntersection_preimage _ V g' W₀ hW p t) s)) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 2) ↪o Fin r) (j : Fin (p + 2)) (B : T'.Opens)
        (s : Γ(H.obj (G.obj (op (alternatingCechIntersection V
          ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j).trans t)))), B)),
        (coefficientSupportIso f' M (W (p + 1) t) B).hom
          ((q (p + 1) t).app B
            ((H.map (G.map (homOfLE
              (alternatingCechIntersection_face_le V p t j)).op)).app B s)) =
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf
          (alternatingCechIntersection_face_le (fun i ↦ W₀ ⟨i⟩) p t j) le_rfl)).op
            ((coefficientSupportIso f' M (W p ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j).trans t)) B).hom
              ((q p ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j).trans t)).app B s)))
